headline: Proposal to put 5% of the value of future-formed housing into a guarantee account
summary: A Ministry of Construction proposal would transfer 5% of the remaining contract value for future-formed housing into a payment guarantee account. Funds would reach the investor only after the buyer receives land and ownership certificates.
why: Pre-sale housing payments are a key funding source for Vietnamese property developers, so changes to escrow rules affect developer cash flow and buyer protection.
